nodes.name: Render Video
nodes.notes: Verify the renderer's exact API path/body in its README. short-video-maker exposes a REST + MCP API on :3123. Poll its status endpoint until the mp4 is ready, then pass the file to the upload node.

nodes.name: YouTube Upload (private)
nodes.notes: Attach YouTube OAuth2 credential. privacyStatus stays 'private' until the compliance audit passes; you tap publish in the app.

_README: STARTER SKELETON — import into n8n (Workflows -> Import from File), then: (1) attach your YouTube OAuth2 credential to the upload node, (2) confirm the renderer API path/body against the short-video-maker README, (3) add a TTS node (edge-tts free or ElevenLabs) before Render if you want narration baked in, (4) add an Images node if using AI stills instead of stock, (5) add a 'notify me' node (Telegram/email) after upload. Full node-by-node guidance is in workflow-blueprint.md.
